integrity: A full symbolic construction labels cross-block pairs negative and places label two on a spanning cycle of the smaller block plus three disjoint pairs of the larger block. The total weight is four; each pair has closed-neighborhood sum W minus two endpoint incidence sums plus twice its own label. The cycle also supplies at least two disjoint label-two defenders for every negative pair. Degree-capacity inequalities and the mandatory nonedge of a spanning two-regular graph rule out smaller weights within the stated two-block class. The standalone definition-level verifier checks both conditions directly for eleven even orders and confirms the endpoint identity for forty-six even orders.
scientific_limitations: An explicit weight-four upper bound for even ground-set order at least ten, not a proof of the unrestricted optimum.
The two-block weight-four sharpness result applies only to functions that are negative exactly on crossing two-sets and take labels one or two internally.
The global lower bound of two from the initiating Kneser study is not improved.
Neither odd-order two-set Kneser graphs nor k-subset Kneser graphs with k at least three are addressed.
The 2025 survey was inspected at the indexed theorem-section level; full publisher-page access was unavailable.
title: Weight-four signed Roman functions on even two-set Kneser graphs
